name: @gaiada/webdesk-site-wsk17-proof
description: WSK-17 - the proof rebuild. A minimal real Astro site built EXCLUSIVELY from the generated TS SDK (webdesk/api/src/codegen) for its own tenant contract plus @gaiada/webdesk-blocks (WSK-16). Zero hand-written backend calls: openapi-fetch is used only as a generic, type-driven HTTP dispatcher parameterised by the generated `paths` type from sdk.d.ts -- it is not a hand-rolled fetch wrapper, it never builds a URL string or names a route by hand anywhere in this package's own source (see README.md's 'why openapi-fetch' section for the honest reasoning and the finding this represents).

scripts.conformance: npm run conformance:compile && npm run conformance:runtime
